svg.title: Package dependency view: Wishem
svg.desc: The view shows 16 packages in 6 layers: layer 1 (Hub), layer 2 (Model and subsystems), layer 3 (Hosts, renderers, and products), layer 4 (Commands), layer 5 (Applications), layer 6 (Checks). Layer 1 is at the bottom and layer 6 is at the top. Each of the 42 arrows goes down from a package to a package that it uses at run time, in dependencies or peerDependencies. A package uses only packages in its own layer or in a lower layer. The line Tests with on a card names the packages that its package has only in devDependencies.
